user.title: Amazon Preisalarm
user.description: Choose how often prices are checked. Afterwards add products via "Add product" on the integration entry.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between two price checks (at least 15 to avoid Amazon's bot protection).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Amazon Preisalarm is already set up. Add more products via "Add product".

user.title: Add product
user.description: Paste an Amazon product link (short links like amzn.eu/d/… work too). The current price is stored as reference price.

data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the product title.
data_description.target_price: Optional. Creates a binary sensor that turns on once the price drops to or below it.
Leave empty to remove the target price sensor.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid Amazon product link.
error.blocked: Amazon blocked the request with a captcha. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_parse: The page could not be recognized as a product page.

abort.already_configured: This product is already being tracked.

no_current_price.message: No current price is known yet.
